items.title: Drowning deaths soar in France as Europe buckles in peak of heatwave
items.description: Forty people have drowned in heatwave-related deaths in France since last Thursday, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says.

items.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back
items.description: Iran's foreign ministry says it made "no new commitments" on nuclear inspections after talks in Switzerland.

items.title: UN commission of inquiry says Israel committing genocide in Gaza by deliberately targeting children
items.description: Israel rejects the new report by the three-member expert panel, calling it a "libellous sham".

items.title: Zambia ex-president's family wins latest legal battle over what should happen to his body
items.description: Edgar Lungu's family and the Zambian government remain in dispute 12 months after he died.

items.title: Trump anticipates better relationship with Colombia under new leader
items.description: Abelardo de la Espriella, who preliminary results suggest is Colombia's next president, had Trump's endorsement.

items.title: Spider which uses spring trap to capture prey discovered in Australia
items.description: Researchers say their hunting method - which allows them to prey on dangerous ants - is unprecedented.

items.title: Montreal shooting leaves officer, civilian and suspect dead
items.description: It was the first time in 24 years that a Montreal police officer was  killed in the line of duty, the city's police chief said.
